points.title: 早年求学
points.description: 伊本·赫勒敦出生于突尼斯的一个安达卢西亚阿拉伯裔学者家庭。他的家族在西班牙穆斯林统治时期曾担任过高级官员，但在收复失地运动后移居北非。在突尼斯，他接受了传统的伊斯兰教育，学习古兰经、阿拉伯语、法学、逻辑学和哲学。这段时期的学习为他后来的学术成就奠定了坚实基础，同时也培养了他对历史和社会现象的敏锐观察力。
points.descriptionEn: Born in Tunis to an Andalusian Arab family of scholars, Ibn Khaldun received a traditional Islamic education, studying Quran, Arabic, jurisprudence, logic, and philosophy. His family had held high positions under Muslim rule in Spain before migrating to North Africa during the Reconquista. This early education laid the foundation for his later academic achievements and developed his keen observation of historical and social phenomena.

points.title: 政治生涯开端
points.description: 1349年，伊本·赫勒敦移居摩洛哥的非斯，开始在马林王朝宫廷中担任书记官。他凭借出色的学识和政治才能迅速获得重用，被任命为御前大臣。然而，宫廷政治的复杂性和权力斗争使他感到厌倦。1352年，他因卷入政治阴谋而被短暂监禁。这段经历让他对政治权力有了深刻认识，也促使他开始思考权力更迭和社会变迁的规律，为他后来提出的历史循环理论提供了现实基础。
points.descriptionEn: Moving to Fez in 1349, Ibn Khaldun began his political career as a secretary in the Marinid dynasty court. His exceptional knowledge and political skills quickly earned him the position of royal secretary. However, the complexities of court politics and power struggles left him disillusioned. In 1352, he was briefly imprisoned due to involvement in political intrigue. This experience gave him profound insights into political power and prompted him to reflect on the patterns of power transitions and social change, laying the groundwork for his later cyclical theory of history.

points.title: 隐居著述
points.description: 在经历了多年的政治动荡后，1375年，伊本·赫勒敦选择隐居于阿尔及利亚的卡鲁安城堡。在这段与世隔绝的时期，他开始撰写其最重要的著作《历史绪论》（Muqaddimah）。这部著作不仅是阿拉伯史学的重要里程碑，也是世界思想史上的经典之作。在《历史绪论》中，他提出了关于文明兴衰、社会凝聚力和群体认同的理论，开创性地将历史研究与社会学、经济学和政治学相结合。这部著作奠定了他作为社会学先驱的地位。
points.descriptionEn: After years of political turmoil, Ibn Khaldun chose seclusion in Qal'at ibn Salama castle in Algeria in 1375. During this period of isolation, he began writing his magnum opus, the 'Muqaddimah' (Introduction to History). This work stands as a milestone in Arab historiography and a classic in world intellectual history. In it, he developed theories on the rise and fall of civilizations, social cohesion, and group identity, pioneering the integration of historical study with sociology, economics, and political science. This work established him as a pioneer of sociology.

points.title: 学术巅峰
points.description: 1382年，伊本·赫勒敦前往埃及开罗，在马穆鲁克王朝宫廷中获得重要职位。他担任过马穆鲁克苏丹的法官和教授，同时在爱资哈尔大学任教。在开罗，他完成了《历史绪论》的最终版本，并开始撰写其庞大的世界历史著作《历史书》（Kitab al-'Ibar）。这一时期是他学术生涯的巅峰，他的思想体系趋于成熟，并获得了广泛的认可。然而，政治斗争仍然困扰着他，他曾两次被短暂监禁，甚至一度被流放到亚历山大港。
points.descriptionEn: In 1382, Ibn Khaldun traveled to Cairo, Egypt, where he held important positions in the Mamluk dynasty court. He served as a judge and professor for the Mamluk sultan and taught at Al-Azhar University. In Cairo, he completed the final version of the 'Muqaddimah' and began writing his monumental world history, the 'Kitab al-'Ibar' (Book of Lessons). This period marked the peak of his academic career, as his thought system matured and gained wide recognition. However, political struggles continued to plague him, leading to two brief imprisonments and even exile to Alexandria at one point.

points.title: 晚年与逝世
points.description: 1401年，伊本·赫勒敦随马穆鲁克军队前往大马士革，试图抵抗帖木儿的入侵。在这期间，他有机会与帖木儿本人会面，并进行了长时间的交谈。这次会面成为历史上著名的学术交流之一。帖木儿对伊本·赫勒敦的学识表示高度赞赏。1406年，伊本·赫勒敦在开罗逝世，享年74岁。他的一生跨越了北非和中东多个政治实体，亲历了王朝更迭和社会变革。他的著作被后世誉为'历史哲学的奠基之作'，对后世的历史学、社会学和政治学产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: In 1401, Ibn Khaldun accompanied the Mamluk army to Damascus to resist Timur's invasion. During this period, he had the opportunity to meet Timur in person and engaged in extensive conversations, becoming one of the most famous academic encounters in history. Timur expressed high admiration for Ibn Khaldun's knowledge. In 1406, Ibn Khaldun died in Cairo at the age of 74. His life spanned multiple political entities across North Africa and the Middle East, witnessing dynastic changes and social transformations. His works were later hailed as 'the foundation of the philosophy of history,' exerting profound influence on subsequent historiography, sociology, and political science.

appraisal.zh: 伊本·赫勒敦在学界通常被视为历史社会学的重要先驱，《历史绪论》将历史研究与社会、经济和政治分析结合，提出文明兴衰与社会凝聚力等理论，其影响远及后世西方思想家。不过也有研究者指出，他的循环史观简化了复杂的历史进程，经验基础主要来自阿拉伯与伊斯兰世界，对其他文明的解释力有限，其政治生涯亦多有摇摆。总体而言，他仍被公认为跨学科研究与文明对话的世界级思想家。
appraisal.en: Ibn Khaldun is generally regarded as a pioneering figure in historiography and sociology: the Muqaddimah combined historical study with social, economic and political analysis, and his theories of civilizational rise and fall and social cohesion influenced later Western thinkers. Yet some researchers note that his cyclical view oversimplifies historical processes, that his evidence derives mainly from the Arab and Islamic world, limiting its explanatory reach, and that his political career was marked by shifting allegiances. Still, he is widely recognized as a world-class thinker and pioneer of interdisciplinary study.

supporter.zh: 伊本·赫勒敦被誉为'历史社会学之父'，他的《历史绪论》开创性地将历史研究与社会学、经济学和政治学相结合，提出了关于文明兴衰、社会凝聚力和群体认同的理论。支持者认为他超越了时代限制，提出了具有现代性的社会科学理论，对后世的历史学、社会学和政治学产生了深远影响。他的思想体系被认为是伊斯兰黄金时代学术成就的巅峰之一，也是世界思想史上的重要里程碑。
supporter.en: Ibn Khaldun is hailed as the 'father of historiography and sociology.' His 'Muqaddimah' pioneered the integration of historical study with sociology, economics, and political science, developing theories on the rise and fall of civilizations, social cohesion, and group identity. Supporters argue that he transcended the limitations of his time, proposing social science theories with modern relevance, and exerting profound influence on subsequent historiography, sociology, and political science. His thought system is considered one of the pinnacles of Islamic Golden Age scholarship and a significant milestone in world intellectual history.

critic.zh: 批评者指出伊本·赫勒敦的理论存在局限性，他的历史循环论过于简化复杂的历史进程，忽视了技术进步和制度创新对历史发展的作用。此外，他的理论主要基于阿拉伯和伊斯兰世界的历史经验，对其他文明的解释力有限。一些学者认为他的政治生涯充满矛盾，多次在统治者之间摇摆，缺乏坚定的政治立场。还有人批评他的著作结构松散，部分论述缺乏严谨的实证支持。
critic.en: Critics point out that Ibn Khaldun's theories have limitations, with his cyclical view of history oversimplifying complex historical processes while neglecting the impact of technological progress and institutional innovation. Additionally, his theories primarily draw from Arab and Islamic historical experiences, limiting their explanatory power for other civilizations. Some scholars note contradictions in his political career, as he frequently shifted between rulers without maintaining consistent political principles. Others criticize his works for their loose structure and lack of rigorous empirical support in certain arguments.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，伊本·赫勒敦被公认为跨学科研究的先驱和世界级思想家。他的著作被翻译成多种语言，影响了从马克思到韦格纳等众多西方思想家。在当代，他被视为全球化背景下文明对话的重要代表，其思想对于理解当代中东社会和政治仍有重要启示。他的生平经历也反映了中世纪伊斯兰世界的知识精英如何在政治动荡中寻求学术独立，这一形象在当代学术界和文化界仍具有广泛影响力。
objective.en: In academic circles and popular culture, Ibn Khaldun is widely recognized as a pioneer of interdisciplinary research and a world-class thinker. His works have been translated into multiple languages and influenced numerous Western thinkers from Marx to Weber. In contemporary contexts, he is regarded as an important representative of civilizational dialogue in an era of globalization, and his ideas continue to offer valuable insights for understanding contemporary Middle Eastern societies and politics. His life story also reflects how intellectual elites in the medieval Islamic world sought academic independence amid political turmoil, an image that remains influential in contemporary academic and cultural circles.

self.zh: 历史是一门关于人类社会及其文明兴衰的科学，它研究人类社会的本质和规律。
self.en: History is a science that deals with human society and the rise and fall of civilizations, studying the nature and laws of human societies.
